note: On a forested point at The Narrows of Waskesiu Lake, 25 km from the Waskesiu townsite on Narrows Road, close to the marina and boat launch. Self-register at the kiosk on arrival: pick a site first, then return to pay. Wi-Fi only in Waskesiu. --Claude
